declarations.type:
∀ {AuthorityId : Type}
  (left right :
    List (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.WeightedAuthorityReport AuthorityId)),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.totalVotingWeight (left ++ right) =
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.totalVotingWeight left +
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.totalVotingWeight right
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.totalVotingWeight_append
ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.concrete_cut_conserves_total_weight

declarations.type:
∀ {AuthorityId : Type}
  {reports :
    List (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.WeightedAuthorityReport AuthorityId)}
  {cutWeight : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.VotingWeight}
  (certificate :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.ConcreteWeightedCut reports cutWeight),
  cutWeight ≤
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.totalVotingWeight certificate.lowerReports +
        certificate.selectedReport.votingWeight ∧
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.totalVotingWeight reports <
      cutWeight +
        (certificate.selectedReport.votingWeight +
          ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.totalVotingWeight certificate.upperReports)
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.concrete_cut_arithmetic_witnesses
ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.selected_below_threshold_covers_lower_partition
ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.selected_above_threshold_covers_upper_partition

declarations.type:
∃ lowerReports selectedReport upperReport cutWeight,
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.totalVotingWeight lowerReports < cutWeight ∧
    cutWeight ≤
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.totalVotingWeight lowerReports +
          selectedReport.votingWeight ∧
      selectedReport.boundValue > upperReport.boundValue
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinConcreteWeightedCut.cumulative_cut_without_value_order_is_insufficient
